question: is it better to save or spend

widget.title: Two weeks, two choices
widget.prompt: Guess which one ends with the bicycle.
widget.a11y_text: Two plans for the same EC$10 a week. Keeping EC$3 a week reaches a bicycle in under a year. Spending all of it reaches nothing, and every week is enjoyable.

panels.label: Keep EC$3
panels.detail: EC$156 by Christmas. Halfway to the bicycle.

panels.label: Spend it all
panels.detail: Fifty-two good weeks and the bicycle is still in the shop. Both are real choices.
